sourceReview.note: Independent sparse observations on raw NAIP cross-sections. Selected asphalt/curb/paint/grass limits exclude adjoining runoff and pit access. Openings, obscured edges and all unmeasured intervals interpolate. Complete overlays reviewed; image sampling and rounding do not establish surveyed accuracy. Draft route identity and historical alignment are unchanged.

networkPropagation.note: Hashes use layoutContentHash: parsed layout JSON with the display-only ideal feature excluded. Exact embedded old component hashes and superseded old border hashes are checked before propagation. Original network trace, timing and terrain are retained.

heldLayouts.reason: The pinned image shows grass along source connector stations approximately 20 through 100. Modern road-edge measurements cannot supply this provisional or historical branch; matching historical limits or a source-route review are needed.
No complete ideal line until every embedded component, including Short, is supported.
